notes.title: We're Working OVERHOURS this Summer... with a New Demo!
notes.content:
Attention Night Owls! 
Don't clock out so soon... our little tower defense game about overworking and sh*tty bosses is releasing a limited time public demo in conjunction with a few summer showcases—

The (new!) Southeast Asian Games Showcase: Summer Game Fest Edition
Celebrating games from developers in Southeast Asia at a global level, happening June 6th - June 20th 2025 on Steam and livestreaming on the SEAGS Youtube channel at: 
🕛June 7, 12PM (PST) / 3PM (EST)
🕛June 8, 2AM (GMT+7) / 3AM (GMT+8)
🕛June 8, 5AM (AEST)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181209/22e8674241c4a5c90f032dd61980e01d1c4aa2a8.png

The MIX Summer Game Showcase: SEAGS Official Selection
Happening online now on Steam and in-person on June 6th, 5pm at the Grammy Museum Rooftop in Los Angeles, CA. If you're at the event and spot our booth, please take some pictures and tag us on social media! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181209/6d139d9690e4e1ca8273791afc2e8193df3f600c.png


Wishlist and get notified for the new limited time demo on June 6th!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2439500/Overhours/

If you encounter any bugs or would like to give us feedback, feel free to join the Overhours community on Discord or X! The agency is always excited to welcome new emplo-, players!

notes.title: Overhours is part of the Laughs & Smiles Game Festival event on Steam!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181209/b87c8d9affdc56cf2d32681d0c2f99418ce017cc.png

Overhours is part of Laughs & Smiles Game Festival, a digital showcase celebrating games that will make you laugh and/or smile!

We're hosting a limited-time public playtest for Overhours in line with the Laughs & Smiles Game Festival! To be part of our playtest, simply head to the game's main page and click the "Request Access" button, wait for your account to be given access and voila! 
Also feel free to join our Discord community and leave us some feedback as we continue building the game. 

The event is hosted on Steam and will happen between January 30th and February 6th (as well as our playtest!). Check it out here: https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/CrunchingKoalas/sale/LaughsAndSmiles2025

notes.title: Post-PAX Aus 2024: Update and Reminder
notes.content:
Happy Halloween & Happy PAX Withdrawals!👻 

The team had a fantastic time at PAX Aus 2024 and we hope you did too! Thank you to everyone who came by the booth to try the game, grabbed some free merch and candy. We're back in our workstations, continuing development based on feedback we've received from yall!

IF you've received a 🎃Halloween postcard🎃 from us (see below), this is a gentle reminder that there is a Steam Key on the back that gives you access to our playtest build. There is no limited time for you to claim the key (for now!), but we would greatly appreciate if you try the build and let us know what you think in our Discord server!

Discord community members will also get notified of future playtester intakes first!


🎃Postcard front and back
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181209/5d34c78abca7ec52ccb92620e7f46bbf6397a005.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181209/10c46014336e46972313a010edd4f3ef5cdc070a.jpg

That's it folks, wishlist Overhours and follow us here for future updates!

notes.title: Play Overhours @ PAX AUS 2024!
notes.content:
HOWDY! We're bringing a new demo to PAX AUS 2024! 😎

The event is happening at the MCEC, Melbourne from 11th - 13th October 2024. You can catch us at Booth 27, in the PAX RISING section by the main entrance/ queue hall. Please feel free to come by and have a go at our new build, or simply have a chat with the team 🗨️ We'll also be giving out Steam playtest keys to anyone who comes to play the demo! 

However we do have a limited number of playtest keys (and merch) to give out each day so do come by as early as you can!

See you at PAX AUS 2024!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181209/955c4dc805522a5fd7a1c82a42f349c23c002c58.png

notes.title: Thank You for Joining Us at LEVEL UP PLAY!
notes.content:
Hello players!

Our team is just unwinding from the recent LEVEL UP PLAY weekend at KLCC and just wanted to say a HUGE THANK YOU to everyone who came by to try our new convention build or simply had a chat with the team! 

A gentle reminder that if you were given a postcard after playing, there is a Steam Key on the back of the card that gives you access to our playtest build— which we update from time to time with feature polishes and gameplay improvements. It features two extra levels compared to what was shown during the event, and more comic cutscenes that give you more context to the game's story! 


So, You Already Claimed the Playtest Key...

Please join our community in the Overhours Discord server! There, you'll be able to leave us with feedback and suggestions as development carries on, and stay-up-to-date with any news from our team. And if you don't have a playtest key, you'll be notified via the server when we open up for more playtesters!

Once again, thank you for your support and we hope to meet everyone soon (or in the server)!ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: LEVEL UP PLAY 2024
notes.content:
New demo at LEVEL UP PLAY 2024!

Hey everyone! It's convention season again and we're kicking it off with LEVEL UP PLAY, happening from 13th-15th September, Friday-Sunday at KLCC (KL Convention Centre). 

You can catch us at the Indie Games Zone, Booth 5092 in Hall 5! Please feel free to come by and have a go at our new build, or simply have a chat with the team 🗨️ We'll also be giving out Steam playtest keys to anyone who comes to play Overhours at our booth! 😁 

However we do have a limited number of playtest keys (and merch!) to give out each day so do come by early!

We're honoured to also be part of the month-long Level Up 2024 Steam event, together with the other games being featured at the show. Check it out here:

LEVEL UP KL 2024 STEAM EVENT

notes.title: Announcing the Southeast Asia Games Onward (SEA GO) Event
notes.content:
Southeast Asia Games Onward (SEA GO) Online Event

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181209/502261c3e9cffb34e976af4fd68e0f16d0cc7702.png

To wrap up 2023, Overhours will be joining the Southeast Asia Games Onward (SEA GO) Online Event, a collaborative video game showcase event running from December 14th, 2023 to February 2nd, 2024!

Players get to browse from a catalogue of 100+ games from Southeast Asian countries such as Malaysia, Singapore, and Indonesia. Try some demos, snag some discounts, get your Christmas shopping done here!

Be sure to also catch part 2 of the event, which is a video showcase featuring all the upcoming and newly released titles from across the region. The video will premiere December 28th, 2023, on SEAGamethetic's Youtube channel.

Check out the event page here: 
https://store.steampowered.com/curator/25278687/sale/SEAGO2023

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44181209/e12fbc6e0c35a3cb4b8963a4da44b1dfafe7640a.png

CtrlD Studio would like to wish everyone a Merry Christmas and Happy 2024!

SEAGO is hosted by Southeast Asia Game Aesthetic (SEAGamethetic), in partnership with Virtual SEA, Asosiasi Game Indonesia, Xbox, Thailand Game Association, Indie Games Group Philippines, Brunei Game Dev, PlayPrime and Indonesia Game Content Creator Group.
